name: agent-eval-harness
description: A portable, deterministic evaluation harness for coding-agent CLIs

scripts.test: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.test-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/tests/**/*.test.js
scripts.eval:baseline:acc: npm run --silent build && node dist/cli/index.js run --agent acc --command acc --suite portable --tier baseline
scripts.eval:baseline:codex: npm run --silent build && node dist/cli/index.js run --agent codex --command codex --suite portable --tier baseline
scripts.eval:baseline:claude: npm run --silent build && node dist/cli/index.js run --agent claude --command claude --suite portable --tier baseline
scripts.eval:challenge:acc: npm run --silent build && node dist/cli/index.js run --agent acc --command acc --suite portable --tier challenge
scripts.eval:challenge:codex: npm run --silent build && node dist/cli/index.js run --agent codex --command codex --suite portable --tier challenge
scripts.eval:challenge:claude: npm run --silent build && node dist/cli/index.js run --agent claude --command claude --suite portable --tier challenge
scripts.eval:full:acc: npm run --silent build && node dist/cli/index.js run --agent acc --command acc --suite portable
scripts.eval:full:codex: npm run --silent build && node dist/cli/index.js run --agent codex --command codex --suite portable
scripts.eval:full:claude: npm run --silent build && node dist/cli/index.js run --agent claude --command claude --suite portable
